statement: A commercial or military vessel is struck, mined, or seized in or near the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-14.
resolution: Resolves true if UKMTO, JMIC, Reuters, or AP report a vessel struck, mined, boarded, or seized in the Strait of Hormuz within the window; false if no such report appears by the deadline.
failure_condition: No UKMTO, JMIC, or wire-service report confirms a vessel attack, mining, or seizure in the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-14.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

failure_condition: Brent front-month crude does not settle at or above USD 95.00 per barrel on any trading day between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-21.
